### 2026-10-31: Starting working on code in Arduino IDE and setup took me a while then I started working on my code. In the the pathfinder guide it said that 90% of the time the pins won't be the same as the ones sho

**1.5h**

Starting working on code in Arduino IDE and setup took me a while then I started working on my code. In the the pathfinder guide it said that 90% of the time the pins won't be the same as the ones shown but mine was the same so I had to cross check to make sure that my variables were set up correctly. I created all of my basic variables (like BUT1-3 and LED1-3) and also made my max levels to 50. **IMPORTANT** i decided to change my game to a memory game because I thought that would be more fun than a reaction game and cooler too. (Which is why this session was long even though I didn't get to code much because I had to re do my code) I also set up the buttons and LED.  When you play the game it starts off at level 0 and my plan is for the more Levels u go through, that many LEDs will light up in a row. Next session I will work on the rest of the code!

### 2026-11-01: I finished up my firmware and it was a bunchhh of work. I basically just took pics of my finalized code but I might fix some of the firmware when I get the supplies shipped to me.

**4h**

I finished up my firmware and it was a bunchhh of work. I basically just took pics of my finalized code but I might fix some of the firmware when I get the supplies shipped to me.
The picture below is the part of the code that checks if player reaches max level (50) then if they do the win sequence will be played (last pic I think) and the code after  just adds more to the sequence based off of the level that ur on. So basically if you get a sequence right, u move onto the next level and itll add one more to the sequence from before.
![Screenshot 2026-11-01 152712](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/xuHXGjbfIPz0CnJ1Vq2xr27VriNQEoOI/5cf0108ece11abde0b321299c71d29181d417d149016ef859c628c034cce50ca.jpg)
The pic below shows that if u miss the sequence then u restart (go back to level 0)
![Screenshot 2026-11-01 152727](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/xuHXGjbfIPz0CnJ1Vq2xr27VriNQEoOI/49ff2a4aa94217f2cda61f8dce197d773d9291066c929a83d05f2010e62bce6b.jpg)
The top part of this pic is just the code to check if button one is pressed long enough and if it is then the game will start after that section it just says that 1=led1 and so on so forth and if that led is chosen it lights up
![Screenshot 2026-11-01 152745](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/xuHXGjbfIPz0CnJ1Vq2xr27VriNQEoOI/57bc9693c4baeca13adff2f173fe7e8ccac927add0c1ec585df1c0cf76ea5b55.jpg)
Basically I set it so that if the first button is clicked for longer than 2 seconds then the game quits (I might hv to change this later and make it button 3 is for quitting tho if its more efficient)  and then if the buttons are pressed its corresponding leds while light up
![Screenshot 2026-11-01 152757](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/xuHXGjbfIPz0CnJ1Vq2xr27VriNQEoOI/826554bbe76eb85e82da837c3e98866ec271fe7cb1654b7dce733bef41e82e6a.jpg)
The gameover sequence (when u miss the sequence) lights up all leds to signify u lost and the quit game sequence only lights up led 2 & 3 (to show some diff) and sets level to 0 and finally the winning sequence lightds up all leds and sets level to 0.
![Screenshot 2026-11-01 152810](https://halflife.hackclub-assets.com/sessions/xuHXGjbfIPz0CnJ1Vq2xr27VriNQEoOI/54a1b386614f83285cf8c48b4f44e8e8497703120897867343df7e32fab8fd3e.jpg)
Im pretty proud of myself I think I learned a lot in this session but it also involved me experiencing a lot of problems but I figured them out by debugging next i think I will submit I might make models for katara sokka and the rest of the gang but i'll do it on my own time because I want to submit the project. I also probably will print out those 3d models myself when I get the 3d printer just so funding is easier.
